fact: The World Bank-funded PATN project opened centres where public-sector agents of the Posts, Telecommunications and Digital Economy department are trained, with sessions of at least 30 hours on database management, per Les Depeches de Brazzaville.
The PATN 2024 work plan includes developing and implementing a digital learning platform for online training in public administration.
